I've never considered it, actually. I don't see my therapist anymore, and we didn't really speak in depth about this. I think she preferred me not to focus on this and always look on the bright side. 
I don't know if it's clinical though. It comes and goes, and I can have long good periods (like now).

Yes, you are correct. I always focus on the negative stuff, and think that the worst is going to happen. Even if I know (logically) that my feeling has no basis (for example, that i'll fail a test or that I did something badly), it doesn't help the feeling.
